sentences.text:
The Court made the following Order:
The controversy in this case lies in a narrow compass.
The fifth respondent filed a counter affidavit stating that underground water pipe line is proposed to be laid in the petitioner`s land for a short length of 245 Mtrs and depth of 2 Mtrs.
Further, 99% of the farmers had given their consent for laying the pipe line, but the work is stalled since the petitioner is unwilling to part with 245 Mtrs of land.

In that view of the matter, the respondent authorities will have to resort the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, by invoking emergency provision under Section 40 of the said Act.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that it would prevail on his client to arrive at a negotiated settlement, particularly, considering the overall public interest involved.

In the circumstances, I deem it appropriate to direct the Collector, Medak District, to take initiative and hold negotiations with the petitioner to resolve the issue in relation to laying of the pipe line.

This Court, has no manner of doubt that the Collector, Medak District, would make sincere efforts to sort out the lis in executing the project of the nature, which would ultimately benefit a large extent of farmers.
The Collector, Medak District, to file his report on or before 14.3.2016.
Interim stay granted earlier shall stand extended by four weeks.
